claims: BravesVision is the exclusive local television network for the Atlanta Braves.
BravesVision launched for the 2026 MLB season.
BravesVision replaces FanDuel Sports Network South.
The Atlanta Braves organization owns BravesVision.
The Atlanta Braves organization operates BravesVision.
BravesVision provides over 140 regular-season games.
BravesVision has no local blackouts.
BravesVision is available via Braves.TV for $99.99 for the season.
BravesVision is available via Braves.TV for $19.99 monthly.
Braves.TV is a platform from MLB.
DIRECTV carries BravesVision on channel 645.
U-verse carries BravesVision on channel 1730.
Xfinity (Comcast) carries BravesVision on channel 1254 in Georgia, Alabama, Mississippi, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Western North Carolina.
Spectrum carries BravesVision.
Fubo includes BravesVision in the base plan.
Select BravesVision games are available over-the-air through Gray Media stations throughout the Southeast.
YouTube TV does not carry BravesVision as of March 27, 2026.
BravesVision territory covers a six-state region including Georgia, Alabama, Mississippi, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Western North Carolina.
BravesVision features live games.
BravesVision features pregame coverage "Braves On Deck".
BravesVision features postgame shows.
The Atlanta Braves handle in-house production for BravesVision.
The Atlanta Braves handle sales for BravesVision.
The Atlanta Braves handle distribution for BravesVision.
Most broadcasters from previous seasons are returning for BravesVision.
Most production staff from previous seasons are returning for BravesVision.
